proposals.description: Update spec to use LoggerComponent instead of LoggerComponentV1
proposals.spec_text: The component MUST be named LoggerComponentV1 and defined using the define_component! macro.
proposals.actual: Component is named LoggerComponent (without V1 suffix) at src/lib.rs:124. The V1 suffix was removed intentionally as part of a codebase-wide naming cleanup.
proposals.resolution: Replace all occurrences of LoggerComponentV1 with LoggerComponent in spec.md
proposals.rationale: The V1 suffix removal was intentional and applied codebase-wide. Only one version exists. The spec should reflect the actual component name.
